assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Concept building density and FAR are estimated from concept cluster footprints times assumed floor counts; official regulatory controls (FAR/height/density/green ratio/setback) are missing and must be confirmed before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: Density, FAR and total floor area are concept evidence only; they will be recalculated once official controls and existing-building data arrive.

assumptions.statement: Road areas are estimated from concept road centerline lengths times assumed widths by class (30/20/25/15/8 m); they are not official road redline areas.
assumptions.impact: Road ratio and road area are concept estimates; official redlines and municipal baselines must replace them for statutory analysis.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, ownership and municipal utility baseline data are not publicly available; retain/renovate/rebuild targets and municipal load estimates are directional until the baseline survey is completed.
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-rebuild conclusions and municipal capacity estimates remain to-be-confirmed and require professional review.

assumptions.statement: Implementation governance, delivery matrix, decision gates, monitoring mechanisms, risk register and operation estimates are concept-level proposals; they require professional, legal and financial review and are not commitments or confirmed government arrangements.
assumptions.impact: Feasibility and operation conclusions are directional and will be refined with official data, ownership baselines and professional review; no statement should be read as an approved implementation plan.

assumptions.statement: Regional synergy directions (Beiwei community, Future Science City, Huairou Science City, Beijing E-Town and the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region) are concept-level collaboration directions derived from the open call; they do not imply confirmed cooperation, entity lists, investment amounts or policy commitments.
assumptions.impact: Regional synergy conclusions are directional; concrete collaboration requires professional teams, relevant parties and official procedures.

assumptions.statement: The public-space component library, wayfinding/symbol system and international communication narrative are concept-level design toolkits; specifications, placements and materials require site conditions, professional review and cleared assets.
assumptions.impact: Component and wayfinding conclusions are directional references for later design deepening, not confirmed construction or installation plans.

assumptions.statement: Cultural-resource system and narrative are compilations and translations of public or cleared materials (heritage sites, historical narratives, Zhongguancun innovation culture, AI open-source culture); exhibitions and installations are concept proposals requiring heritage, copyright and public-participation review.
assumptions.impact: Cultural narrative conclusions are directional; specific exhibitions, installations and content require professional review and cleared assets and are not confirmed arrangements.
